selection_rule: An AI-attributed atomic commit enters only when a reproducible state-transition witness proves that it introduced a concrete unsafe primitive, a distinct later commit activated that exact primitive on the advisory mechanism path, and line-level provenance binds both roles. The AI commit need not be independently exploitable.
generation_boundary: This ledger was frozen only after the source-independent prospective inventory, ChurchCRM mechanical witness, and both independent model-review artifacts were sealed. It is evaluation-only and must not enter candidate generation, prioritization, prompts, or model routing.
claim_boundary: A compositional causal contributor is not counted as an independently exploitable AI root. One advisory mechanism is one deduplicated finding even when several commits supply the primitive, activation, source, and sink; every contributing SHA remains visible in the mechanism provenance.

controls.mechanism: The directly Copilot-co-authored member introduced is_valid_db_password as a non-empty-only validator while the setup route still referenced the removed strict helper. After a raw-password change and a second Copilot refactor left the route broken, a human commit repaired dispatch by selecting the permissive AI-authored helper. Attacker-controlled DB_PASSWORD then reaches str_replace into a single-quoted PHP configuration assignment without escaping.
